layout_patterns: Left-aligned headline with right-aligned portrait or hero image
Full-width hero section with dark overlay and centered text
Three-column grid for program cards or case studies
Alternating image-text blocks with generous white space
Rounded circular photo frames with cyan border accent
Geometric shapes (rectangles, lines) layered behind or alongside imagery
Centered stat blocks with navy background and white text
photographic_style: Professional corporate portraiture with warm, neutral lighting; subjects against blurred modern office backgrounds; lifestyle and campus imagery with cool color grading; high-contrast black-and-white candid shots mixed with vibrant color photography.
logo_treatment: IE logo appears top-right with 'BUSINESS SCHOOL' tagline in navy background panel; clear space maintained around wordmark; consistent placement across templates.
things_to_avoid: Overly playful or casual imagery for executive programs
Heavy use of bright warm colors competing with navy and cyan
Serif typography for headlines or CTAs
Inconsistent photo color grading across sections
Placing logo other than top-right corner
